properties.description: 재수행 (v8.3) : 이전 마스터(p_master_run_id)의 실패 수집 행만 같은 master_run_id 로 다시 수행. Start_retry -> ForEach dispatcher -> End_retry -> Upd_init_wait_yn -> Req_end

activities.name: Start_retry
activities.description: 대상 Master 검증 + RUNNING 전환 + 미성공 수집 행 PENDING 초기화 (재시도 0)

text.value:
/* pl_cmn_orch_retry > Script "Start_retry" (v8.3)
   이전 마스터 실행(p_master_run_id)의 미성공 수집 행만 같은 master_run_id 로 다시 수행 (in-place 재수행)
     같은 master_run_id 를 쓰는 이유 : 파티션 묶음 (master_run_id, target_id) 의 FULL_DELETE_INSERT 를 DBX 가 한 번에 처리하므로
                                    성공한 파티션은 두고 실패한 파티션만 다시 수집하면 묶음이 완성됨. 경로 · 파일명 · 추출쿼리도 그대로 (실패 파일 덮어쓰기)
   대상 : 이 Master 의 수집 이력 중 FAILED / RUNNING / PENDING (Master 가 끝난 뒤 남은 RUNNING · PENDING 은 죽은 행). p_target_ids 로 일부만 가능
   조건 : Master 가 FAILED. RUNNING 으로 남은 Master (ADF 취소 등으로 End_master_run 이 못 돈 경우) 는 p_force_yn = Y 일 때만
   처리 (한 문장, 실패하면 모두 취소)
     Master  FAILED -> RUNNING, end_dt / error_log 비움, run_param.retry 배열에 이번 재수행 기록 (run_id, 요청자, 대상, 이전 상태 · 오류)
     수집 행 -> PENDING, attempt_no + 1, 시작 · 종료 · 건수 · 크기 초기화, 이전 오류는 '[이전 시도 N] ' 로 남김
     재수집 요청 (REQUEST 실행) : 재수행 대상 Target 의 FAILED 요청 -> RUNNING (Req_end 가 다시 판정)
   검증 실패 (형변환 오류, 아무것도 바뀌지 않음)
     RETRY_PARAM_MISSING / RETRY_MASTER_NOT_FOUND:id / RETRY_MASTER_STATUS:id/상태
     TARGET_NOT_IN_RETRY:ids (지정 target 에 미성공 행 없음) / RETRY_NO_FAILED_CHILD:id (수집 이력 자체가 없음 -> 마스터 재실행)
     RETRY_CONCURRENT:id (다른 재수행이 먼저 Master 를 RUNNING 으로 바꿈)
   ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용. Script 재시도 = 0 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'), '')                      AS master_run_id,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}'), '')::jsonb                  AS target_ids,
           upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_force_yn}'), ''), 'N')) = 'Y' AS force_yn,
           NULLIF(trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_requester}'), '')                          AS requester,
           '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                                                     AS retry_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                                               AS created_by
),
/* 대상 Master */
m AS (
    SELECT m.master_run_id, m.status
      FROM adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
      JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = m.master_run_id
),
/* 지정 target_id */
req AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT x::bigint AS target_id
      FROM p, jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p.target_ids, '[]'::jsonb)) x
),
/* 재수행 대상 수집 행 : 미성공 (FAILED / 남은 RUNNING · PENDING) */
f AS (
    SELECT i.ingest_pipeline_id, i.target_id
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run i
      JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = i.master_run_id
     WHERE i.status IN ('FAILED', 'RUNNING', 'PENDING')
       AND (p.target_ids IS NULL OR i.target_id IN (SELECT target_id FROM req))
),
/* 지정했지만 재수행할 행이 없는 target_id */
nf AS (
    SELECT string_agg(r.target_id::text, ',' ORDER BY r.target_id) AS ids
      FROM req r
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM f WHERE f.target_id = r.target_id)
),
ok AS (
    SELECT 1 AS ok
      FROM m, p
     WHERE (m.status = 'FAILED' OR (p.force_yn AND m.status = 'RUNNING'))
       AND (SELECT ids FROM nf) IS NULL
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM f)
),
/* 1. Master -> RUNNING (동시 재수행 방지 : 갱신 시점 상태로 다시 확인) */
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
       SET status     = 'RUNNING',
           end_dt     = NULL,
           error_log  = NULL,
           run_param  = COALESCE(m.run_param, '{}'::jsonb)
                        || jsonb_build_object('retry',
                               COALESCE(m.run_param -> 'retry', '[]'::jsonb)
                               || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                                      'run_id',      p.retry_run_id,
                                      'dt',          to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),
                                      'requester',   p.requester,
                                      'target_ids',  p.target_ids,
                                      'child_cnt',   (SELECT count(*) FROM f),
                                      'prev_status', m.status,
                                      'prev_error',  left(m.error_log, 500))))),
           updated_by = p.created_by,
           updated_dt = now()
      FROM p
     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ok)
       AND (m.status = 'FAILED' OR (p.force_yn AND m.status = 'RUNNING'))
    RETURNING m.master_run_id
),
/* 2. 수집 행 -> PENDING (attempt_no + 1) */
upd AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run i
       SET status                 = 'PENDING',
           attempt_no             = i.attempt_no + 1,
           ingest_pipeline_run_id = NULL,
           start_dt               = NULL,
           end_dt                 = NULL,
           extract_cnt            = 0,
           save_cnt               = 0,
           file_size_mb           = 0,
           read_size_mb           = 0,
           error_log              = CASE WHEN i.error_log IS NULL THEN NULL
                                         ELSE left('[이전 시도 ' || i.attempt_no || '] ' || i.error_log, 4000) END,
           updated_by             = p.created_by,
           updated_dt             = now()
      FROM f, p
     WHERE i.ingest_pipeline_id = f.ingest_pipeline_id
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mst)
    RETURNING i.ingest_pipeline_id, i.master_run_id, i.ingest_pipeline_nm, i.extract_query, i.landing_path, i.file_name,
              i.sink_table_full_nm, i.target_id, i.run_type_cd, i.src_db_nm, i.src_schema_nm, i.src_table_nm,
              i.cdc_tgt_db_nm, i.cdc_tgt_schema_nm, i.sink_type_cd, i.load_method_cd, i.partition_value, i.partition_cnt,
              i.attempt_no, i.status
),
/* 3. 재수집 요청 (REQUEST 실행) : 재수행 Target 의 FAILED 요청 -> RUNNING */
rq AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
       SET status     = 'RUNNING',
           done_dt    = NULL,
           error_log  = NULL,
           updated_by = p.created_by,
           updated_dt = now()
      FROM p
     WHERE q.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND q.status = 'FAILED'
       AND q.target_id IN (SELECT target_id FROM f)
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mst)
    RETURNING q.request_id
)
/* ForEach 입력 (검증 실패 시 chk 형변환 오류로 문장 전체 취소) */
SELECT u.ingest_pipeline_id,
       u.master_run_id,
       u.ingest_pipeline_nm,
       u.extract_query,
       COALESCE(u.landing_path, '')       AS landing_path,
       COALESCE(u.file_name, '')          AS file_name,
       COALESCE(u.sink_table_full_nm, '') AS sink_table_full_nm,
       u.target_id, u.run_type_cd, u.src_db_nm, u.src_schema_nm, u.src_table_nm, u.cdc_tgt_db_nm, u.cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
       u.sink_type_cd, u.load_method_cd, u.partition_value, u.partition_cnt, u.attempt_no, u.status,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM rq) AS request_reset_cnt,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT master_run_id FROM p) IS NULL
            THEN ('RETRY_PARAM_MISSING:p_master_run_id' || (SELECT COALESCE(master_run_id, '') FROM p))::int
            WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM m) = 0
            THEN ('RETRY_MASTER_NOT_FOUND:' || (SELECT master_run_id FROM p))::int
            WHEN (SELECT NOT (m.status = 'FAILED' OR (p.force_yn AND m.status = 'RUNNING')) FROM m, p)
            THEN ('RETRY_MASTER_STATUS:' || (SELECT m.master_run_id || '/' || m.status FROM m))::int
            WHEN (SELECT ids FROM nf) IS NOT NULL
            THEN ('TARGET_NOT_IN_RETRY:' || (SELECT ids FROM nf))::int
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM f)
            THEN ('RETRY_NO_FAILED_CHILD:' || (SELECT master_run_id FROM p))::int
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mst)
            THEN ('RETRY_CONCURRENT:' || (SELECT master_run_id FROM p))::int
            ELSE 1 END AS chk
  FROM (SELECT 1) d
  LEFT JOIN upd u ON TRUE
 ORDER BY u.target_id, u.partition_value;

activities.name: ForEach_child_ingest
activities.description: 재수행 대상 수집 행별 자식 수집 파이프라인 호출 (원래 master_run_id 로)

activities.name: End_retry
activities.description: 대상 Master 상태 재집계 + run_param.retry 결과 기록

text.value:
/* End_retry : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). 대상 Master 전체 수집 이력으로 상태 재집계 (이전 성공 행 포함)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계. run_param.retry 마지막 항목에 결과 기록 */
WITH c AS (
    SELECT count(*)                                                        AS total_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED')                    AS succ_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','RUNNING','PENDING')) AS fail_cnt
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
     WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'
       AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
)
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
   SET child_total_cnt = c.total_cnt,
       child_succ_cnt  = c.succ_cnt,
       child_fail_cnt  = c.fail_cnt,
       status          = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
       error_log       = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN m.error_log
                              ELSE '수집 실패 ' || c.fail_cnt || '건 (ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 확인)' END,
       end_dt          = now(),
       run_param       = CASE WHEN m.run_param -> 'retry' IS NULL THEN m.run_param
                              ELSE jsonb_set(m.run_param, '{retry,-1,result}',
                                             to_jsonb(CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END)) END,
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'
   AND m.status = 'RUNNING';

activities.name: Upd_init_wait_yn
activities.description: INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH 전체 수집 성공 Target -> init_wait_yn = N (해당 없으면 0건)

text.value:
/* Upd_init_wait_yn (재수행) : 대상 Master 기준. INIT_LOAD / FULL_REFRESH 수집(전체 파일)이 모두 SUCCEEDED 인 Target 의 init_wait_yn 을 N 으로 변경
   대상 : 이 실행(master_run_id)의 수집 이력 중 run_type_cd IN (INIT_LOAD, FULL_REFRESH), SKIPPED 제외
          Target 별로 파티션 행 전체가 SUCCEEDED 일 때만 (하나라도 FAILED / RUNNING / PENDING 이면 유지 = Y)
          PARTIAL_REFRESH 는 전체 수집이 아니므로 제외. 이미 N 인 Target(FULL_REFRESH) 은 변경 없음
   ADF 수집(GEN2 저장) 기준. DBX 적재 결과와 무관. ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'::text        AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text  AS created_by
),
t AS (
    SELECT i.target_id
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run i
      JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = i.master_run_id
     WHERE i.run_type_cd IN ('INIT_LOAD', 'FULL_REFRESH')
       AND i.status <> 'SKIPPED'
     GROUP BY i.target_id
    HAVING count(*) = count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'SUCCEEDED')
),
u AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
       SET init_wait_yn = 'N',
           updated_by   = p.created_by,
           updated_dt   = now()
      FROM t, p
     WHERE m.target_id = t.target_id
       AND m.init_wait_yn = 'Y'
       AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
    RETURNING m.target_id
)
SELECT count(*)                                        AS init_done_cnt,
       COALESCE(string_agg(target_id::text, ',' ORDER BY target_id), '') AS init_done_ids
  FROM u;

activities.name: Req_end
activities.description: 재수집 요청 종료 / 기준값 갱신 (REQUEST · FULL_REFRESH 실행일 때만, 그 외 0건)

text.value:
/* pl_cmn_orch_retry > Script "Req_end" (대상 Master 기준, pl_raw_orch_init 의 Req_end 와 같은 로직) (v8.3 개정, adf_script_v83_request_end.sql)
   End_master_run / Fail_master_run 등 앞 단계가 모두 끝난 뒤 실행. 해당 없는 실행에서는 대상 0건
   A. REQUEST 실행 : 이 실행이 확보한 RUNNING 요청 -> DONE (Target 의 수집 이력 모두 SUCCEEDED) / FAILED. DONE 이면 요청 파티션의 기준값을 요청을 만든 체크 값으로 갱신
   B. FULL_REFRESH 실행 : FULL_REFRESH 수집이 모두 성공한 Target -> FULL 권고(HOLD) DONE, 기준값 교체, 같은 Target 의 PENDING 부분 요청 CANCELED
   ADF 수집(GEN2 저장) 기준. ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().parameters.p_master_run_id}'::text        AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text  AS created_by
),

/* A. REQUEST 실행 : 이 실행이 확보한 요청 */
req AS (
    SELECT q.*
      FROM adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = q.master_run_id
     WHERE q.status = 'RUNNING'
),

/* Target 별 수집 결과 */
res AS (
    SELECT r.target_id,
           count(i.ingest_pipeline_id)                                       AS total_cnt,
           count(i.ingest_pipeline_id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'SUCCEEDED') AS succ_cnt
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT target_id FROM req) r
      CROSS JOIN p
      LEFT JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run i
             ON i.master_run_id = p.master_run_id AND i.target_id = r.target_id AND i.status <> 'SKIPPED'
     GROUP BY r.target_id
),

/* 요청 상태 갱신 */
upd AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
       SET status     = CASE WHEN s.total_cnt > 0 AND s.succ_cnt = s.total_cnt THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
           done_dt    = now(),
           error_log  = CASE WHEN s.total_cnt > 0 AND s.succ_cnt = s.total_cnt THEN NULL
                            WHEN s.total_cnt = 0 THEN '수집 이력 없음 (Start_ingest_pipeline Script 실패 확인)'
                            ELSE '수집 실패 ' || (s.total_cnt - s.succ_cnt) || '건 / ' || s.total_cnt || '건' END,
           updated_by = p.created_by,
           updated_dt = now()
      FROM res s, p
     WHERE q.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM req) AND q.target_id = s.target_id
    RETURNING q.request_id, q.target_id, q.status
),

/* 기준값 대상 : DONE 된 정합성 요청의 파티션 + 그 체크의 값 (Target, 파티션별 최신 요청 1건) */
base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (q.target_id, x.pv)
           q.target_id, x.pv, q.check_run_id, v.row_cnt, v.max_val, v.hash_val,
           (v.row_cnt IS NOT NULL) AS exists_yn
      FROM req q
      JOIN res s ON s.target_id = q.target_id AND s.total_cnt > 0 AND s.succ_cnt = s.total_cnt
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(e, '(NULL)') AS pv
                            FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(q.partition_val) e) x
      LEFT JOIN adfadm.ctl_partition_check c
             ON c.master_run_id = q.check_run_id AND c.target_id = q.target_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.row_cnt, r.max_val, r.hash_val
                           FROM jsonb_to_recordset(c.result_json) AS r(part_key text, row_cnt bigint, max_val text, hash_val text)
                          WHERE COALESCE(r.part_key, '(NULL)') = x.pv) v ON TRUE
     WHERE q.request_src_cd = 'INTEGRITY' AND q.check_run_id IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY q.target_id, x.pv, q.requested_dt DESC, q.request_id DESC
),

/* B. FULL_REFRESH 실행 : 이 실행에서 FULL_REFRESH 수집이 모두 성공한 Target */
full_tgt AS (
    SELECT i.target_id
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run i JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = i.master_run_id
     WHERE i.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH' AND i.status <> 'SKIPPED'
     GROUP BY i.target_id
    HAVING count(*) = count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'SUCCEEDED')
),

/* 그 Target 의 FULL 권고 중 가장 최근 1건 (기준값 교체용 체크) */
full_hold AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (q.target_id) q.target_id, q.check_run_id, c.result_json, c.check_to_key
      FROM adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
      JOIN full_tgt f ON f.target_id = q.target_id
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_partition_check c ON c.master_run_id = q.check_run_id AND c.target_id = q.target_id
     WHERE q.status = 'HOLD' AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH' AND q.request_src_cd = 'INTEGRITY'
     ORDER BY q.target_id, q.requested_dt DESC, q.request_id DESC
),

/* FULL 권고 DONE, 부분 재수집 대기 요청 CANCELED */
full_upd AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q
       SET status        = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'CANCELED' END,
           master_run_id = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN p.master_run_id ELSE q.master_run_id END,
           done_dt       = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN now() ELSE q.done_dt END,
           error_log     = CASE WHEN q.status = 'HOLD' THEN NULL
                                ELSE 'FULL_REFRESH 로 대체 (' || p.master_run_id || ')' END,
           updated_by    = p.created_by,
           updated_dt    = now()
      FROM p
     WHERE q.target_id IN (SELECT target_id FROM full_tgt)
       AND q.request_src_cd = 'INTEGRITY'
       AND (   (q.status = 'HOLD' AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH')
            OR (q.status = 'PENDING' AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'))
    RETURNING q.request_id, q.status
),

/* FULL 기준값 : 체크 값 전체 */
full_cur AS (
    SELECT h.target_id, h.check_run_id, h.check_to_key,
           COALESCE(x.part_key, '(NULL)') AS pv, x.row_cnt, x.max_val, x.hash_val
      FROM full_hold h
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(h.result_json) AS x(part_key text, row_cnt bigint, max_val text, hash_val text)
),

/* 기준값 반영 (A + B, Target 이 겹치지 않음) */
base_up AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_partition_state
          (target_id, partition_value, row_cnt, max_val, hash_val, check_run_id, collect_run_id, created_by)
    SELECT b.target_id, b.pv, b.row_cnt, b.max_val, b.hash_val, b.check_run_id, p.master_run_id, p.created_by
      FROM base b CROSS JOIN p
     WHERE b.exists_yn
    UNION ALL
    SELECT f.target_id, f.pv, f.row_cnt, f.max_val, f.hash_val, f.check_run_id, p.master_run_id, p.created_by
      FROM full_cur f CROSS JOIN p
    ON CONFLICT (target_id, partition_value) DO UPDATE
       SET row_cnt = EXCLUDED.row_cnt, max_val = EXCLUDED.max_val, hash_val = EXCLUDED.hash_val,
           check_run_id = EXCLUDED.check_run_id, collect_run_id = EXCLUDED.collect_run_id,
           updated_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, updated_dt = now()
    RETURNING target_id
),
base_del AS (
    DELETE FROM adfadm.ctl_partition_state s
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base b
                    WHERE NOT b.exists_yn AND s.target_id = b.target_id AND s.partition_value = b.pv)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM full_hold h
                    WHERE h.target_id = s.target_id
                      AND (   h.check_to_key IS NULL OR s.partition_value = '(NULL)'
                           OR s.partition_value COLLATE "C" < h.check_to_key COLLATE "C")
                      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM full_cur f
                                       WHERE f.target_id = s.target_id AND f.pv = s.partition_value))
    RETURNING s.target_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upd)                              AS request_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd WHERE status = 'DONE')        AS done_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd WHERE status = 'FAILED')      AS failed_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM full_upd WHERE status = 'DONE')   AS full_done_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM full_upd WHERE status = 'CANCELED') AS full_canceled_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM base_up)                          AS state_upsert_cnt,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM base_del)                         AS state_delete_cnt;
